spec.description:
DCT XPS GA 300 is a closed-cell, high-compressive-strength,
low-moisture-absorption extruded polystyrene (XPS) general application rigid
insulation board for roofs, walls, and floors in commercial and residential
buildings. Manufactured in accordance with EN 13164 with zero Ozone Depletion
Potential (ODP) and CFC/HCFC-free blowing agents, it offers exceptional
compressive strength of 300 kPa and long-term dimensional stability. It
maintains superior thermal performance even under extreme conditions of
compressive loading, ground moisture, and freeze-thaw cycles.
features: High compressive strength minimum 300 kPa (average 350 kPa to AS 2498.3)
Closed cell structure provides near-zero water absorption (< 0.3% by volume)

Long-term thermal performance with low thermal conductivity (0.028 - 0.034
W/m·K)

Specially designed tongue and groove edge profile for airtight,
continuous thermal layering

High resistance to freeze-thaw cycles and ground
moisture

Rot-proof, dimensionally stable, and resistant to compression creep
up to 50 years

Lightweight, rigid, and clean to handle and cut with a knife
or saw
Zero ODP, CFC and HCFC free formulation compliant with Green Star

Suitable for inverted roofs (IRMA), green roofs, under-slab, cavity walls, and
cold stores

Euroclass E to EN 13501-1; Contains flame retardant additives; Must
be protected by thermal barrier in accordance with NCC
spec.compliance: AS 2498.3, EN 13164, EN 1606, Green Star compliant, NCC Volume One and Two
spec.sustainability:
CFC and HCFC free, zero Ozone Depletion Potential (ODP), 100%
recyclable polystyrene
install:
Ensure subgrade, slab, or roof
waterproofing membrane is clean, smooth, and free of debris

For under-slab
applications, lay boards directly over prepared blinding layer or damp-proof
membrane

Interlock tongue and groove edges tightly to eliminate thermal
bridging and gap formation

Stagger end joints in a brick-bond pattern for
structural stability

For inverted roofs (IRMA), lay boards loosely over
waterproofing membrane followed by ProctorGeo IRMA geotextile and ballast

For
cavity walls, secure boards against inner masonry leaf using mechanical
retaining clips on wall ties

Cut easily with a fine-toothed saw or hot wire
cutter around penetrations and footings
selection_checklist:
Confirm
compressive load requirements (GA 300 provides 300 kPa for standard
commercial/residential floors and roofs)

Select required board thickness
(e.g. 50mm R1.70, 75mm R2.55, 100mm R3.40) to meet target R-value

Verify edge
profile requirements (tongue and groove standard for continuous thermal layer)

Confirm ballast requirement for inverted roof assemblies (gravel, pavers, or
green roof soil)

Ensure compatibility with adjacent waterproofing membranes
and solvent-free adhesives
accessories:
ProctorGeo IRMA (filter fabric
for inverted roofs)
limitations:
Must not come
into direct contact with solvent-based waterproofing, petroleum fuels, or coal
tar

Must be protected from
extended outdoor UV exposure prior to covering

Requires concrete ballast or
pavers on inverted flat roofs to prevent wind uplift and flotation
spec.warranty:
Backed by DCTech product warranty (life equivalent to the
structure)

problem_keywords: waterproofing membrane exposed to UV on flat roof
use_cases:
Under-slab thermal insulation beneath
concrete raft slabs to meet 7-star NatHERS energy ratings

Inverted roof
membrane assemblies (IRMA) protecting flat roof waterproofing under ballast or
pavers

Heavy-load commercial cool room floors requiring high compressive
strength (300 kPa)

Cavity wall continuous thermal insulation in double-brick
or precast concrete construction
not_for:
Acoustic airborne sound
absorption inside open cavities (use fibrous batts)
Contact with solvent-based adhesives or coal-tar membranes
retrieval.rag_summary:
DCTech DCT XPS GA (DCT XPS GA 300) is a rigid,
high-compressive-strength (300 kPa) extruded polystyrene insulation board
engineered for under-slab, inverted flat roof (IRMA), green roof, and cavity
wall applications. Featuring a 100% closed-cell structure with near-zero water
absorption (<0.3%) and tongue-and-groove edges, it delivers durable thermal
performance (conductivity 0.028-0.034 W/m·K) that resists compression creep,
ground moisture, and freeze-thaw degradation over a 50-year design life.
Manufactured with zero ODP and CFC/HCFC-free blowing agents, it provides
high-load thermal buffering beneath concrete slabs and protected membrane
roofs.
